Aisha: quick heads-up, new reranker int8 bring-up shows odd metric split: NDCG@10 flat, MRR@10 down ~5%.
Marco: numbers?
Aisha: float MRR@10=0.512, int8=0.486, NDCG almost identical. run id: run/2026-04-02/17
Riley: did any candidate preprocessing change? unicode, trimming, or URL cleaning?
Aisha: we recently added a lightweight URL-normaliser that collapses query params. sample candidate before/after:
```
before: "https://example.com/path?utm=1&ref=abc"
after:  "https://example.com/path"
```
Aisha: tokenizer now sometimes drops trailing slash token in some cases, shifting token boundaries for short candidates.
Marco: interesting — MRR sensitive to top1 reorder. Could also be PTQ microkernels behaving differently for those edge tokens. What PTQ did you use?
Aisha: PTQ=dynamic int8, per_channel=false, calib=3k, seed=9
Riley: quick experiment: revert url normaliser and run 1k probe -> MRR back to 0.509. With normaliser plus per_channel=true -> 0.508. So normaliser is primary cause here.
Aisha: plan: 1) tweak normaliser to preserve trailing slash token, 2) run per_channel PTQ sweep, 3) shadowbench 10k A/B.
ops-bot: shadowbench queued sb-802 est 1.5h
Marco: also add a tiny unit test to serializer covering url edgecases and a rerank-smoke injecting short-url candidates.
Aisha: will open PRs and attach bench diffs. thanks all.
ops-bot: sb-802 complete: patched normaliser vs baseline -> NDCG@10 +0.1%, MRR@10 +3.2% (patched wins)
